title: mut.concept_more_than_human
mutation_directive: Channel POST-HUMAN / MORE-THAN-HUMAN aesthetics (the 2020s expansion of relational aesthetics — Donna Haraway's 'kin', Anna Tsing's 'mushroom at the end of the world'). Translate: the piece's behaviour should look NOT-HUMAN-CENTERED. Slime mold pheromone trails, fungal anastomosis, ant decision-making, microbial mat layering — pick one non-human cognition and let it drive the visual. Avoid the human gaze: no portrait orientation, no symmetric composition, no center-stage. The piece should feel like watching a forest floor at night, with nothing performing for you.
